notes: No designer guide. Facts come from the package types; the summary, when present, is the component's own JSDoc; the example only shows the public API and is not design guidance.
summary: Screen component that acts as the outer most container providing the background color.

examples.purpose: A screen's outermost container holding the page flow.
examples.jsx:
<Screen modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <VStack modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
    <Title title="Personal loan" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  </VStack>
</Screen>
